name: 4390-solodecode-dsv2lite-8gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, bf16. Ungated on the Hub, ~31 GB, not in the local HF cache, so the first run downloads it.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention eight ways (dp8).
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 15.7B total / 2.4B active: 27 layers, hidden 2048, 16 heads, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64), 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, vocab 102400, 4096 trained positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 200 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn over `/v1/completions`: 512 prompt tokens and 256 generated tokens, both fixed (stdev 0), with `ignore_eos` true and `temperature: 0.0` in `backend.extras.body` so every request generates exactly 256 tokens. Seed 4390.
purpose: A code-completion helper serving one user at a time, 512-token prompts and 256-token replies, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit f141298a3c6b84679fae52ec804c8ba32e8cd82c. Flat `key: value` only -- the reader
# takes the file line by line and skips indented ones, so a structured value must stay on ONE line
# or the key is silently dropped and the engine starts without it at rc=0.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
dp-size: 8

# 4096 is the checkpoint's own pre-YaRN window and the longest request here is 512 + 256 = 768,
# so nothing is truncated. LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions,
# and the engine sizes a device-side int32 req_to_token table of (max requests + 1) x (context
# length + 4) from that number -- over a terabyte at the advertised window, and the server never
# starts.
context-length: 4096

# The engine's own default at tp-size 8, written out rather than left to derive.
mem-fraction-static: 0.81

random-seed: 42
